system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: When the Responses API receives a prompt, it assembles model context: user prompt, prior conversation state, and tool instructions.
system_prompt_style.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Orchestrating the agent loop
system_prompt_style.note: Skill metadata is also injected before the call, which is why this is coded dynamically_composed. No system-prompt code is available.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: A better pattern is to stage resources in the container file system and let the model decide what to open, parse, or transform with shell commands.

context_compaction.evidence_locator: paper Sec. When the context window gets full: compaction
context_compaction.note: There is also a per-command output cap that preserves the beginning and end of the output ('The Responses API enforces that cap and returns a bounded result'). The compaction item is model-generated and encrypted.
